# aos7-mailtodo

唯讀彙總 node 信件；不修復或修改資料。

## 第一次跑

```sh
python3 packs/mailtodo/bin/aos7-mailtodo NODE_FOLDER --now 2026-10-09T18:30:00+00:00
```

成功時 stdout 只有一行 JSON，包含 `v`、`open`、`boxes`、`bad`。`--now` 必須是帶時區的 ISO 日期時間；信件中未帶時區的 `at` 使用該時區。輸入不是資料夾或參數無效時，退出碼為 2，stdout 為空。

只檢查非隱藏郵箱的 `inbox/*.md` 和 `inbox/done/*.md`；不跟隨信件檔案的符號連結。資料異常列入 `bad`，不改動原檔。

測試：`python3 proto7-2/tests/run_all.py packs/mailtodo/tests`。

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read-only mailtodo entry point."""
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
import aos7_mailtodo

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(aos7_mailtodo.main())

"""CLI tests for read-only mailtodo summaries."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest


ENTRY = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "bin" / "aos7-mailtodo"
NOW = "2026-10-09T18:30:00+00:00"


def run(folder, now=NOW):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ENTRY), str(folder), "--now", now],
                          capture_output=True, text=True)


def put(root, relative, ident, status, at, reply=None, sender="sender", to="recipient"):
    path = root / relative
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    lines = ["---", "id: " + ident, "from: " + sender, "to: " + to,
             "status: " + status, "at: " + at]
    if reply is not None:
        lines.append("re: " + reply)
    path.write_text("\n".join(lines + ["---", "body", ""]), encoding="utf-8")
    return path


class MailtodoTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_summary_filters_invalid_letters_and_resolves_across_boxes(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            (root / "empty" / "inbox").mkdir(parents=True)
            put(root, "alice/inbox/20261009T1800-request.md", "q", "REQUEST",
                "2026-10-09T18:00:00+00:00")
            put(root, "alice/inbox/20261009T1810-progress.md", "p", "PROGRESS",
                "2026-10-09T18:10:00+00:00", "q")
            put(root, "alice/inbox/20261009T1840-future.md", "future", "REQUEST",
                "2026-10-09T18:40:00", to="outside")
            put(root, "alice/inbox/done/20261009T1820-archive.md", "archived", "REQUEST",
                "2026-10-09T18:20:00+00:00")
            put(root, "bob/inbox/done/20261009T1815-reply.md", "reply", "DONE",
                "2026-10-09T18:15:00+00:00", "q")
            put(root, "bob/inbox/done/20261009T1821-block.md", "block", "BLOCKED",
                "2026-10-09T18:21:00+00:00", "archived")
            invalid = root / "alice/inbox/20261009T1700-no-front.md"
            invalid.write_text("body\n", encoding="utf-8")
            missing = root / "alice/inbox/20261009T1701-no-field.md"
            missing.write_text("---\nid: \nfrom: sender\nto: recipient\nstatus: REQUEST\nat: bad\n---\n",
                               encoding="utf-8")
            put(root, "alice/inbox/wrong-name.md", "wrong", "REQUEST", NOW)
            put(root, "alice/inbox/20261009T1850-duplicate.md", "future", "FAILED",
                NOW, "future")
            put(root, "alice/inbox/.hidden.md", "hidden", "REQUEST", NOW)
            put(root, "alice/inbox/nested/20261009T1800-nested.md", "nested", "REQUEST", NOW)
            put(root, ".hidden/inbox/20261009T1800-hidden.md", "other", "REQUEST", NOW)
            result = run(root)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
            self.assertEqual(result.stdout.count("\n"), 1)
            value = json.loads(result.stdout)
            self.assertEqual(set(value), {"v", "open", "boxes", "bad"})
            self.assertIs(type(value["v"]), int)
            self.assertEqual(value["v"], 1)
            self.assertEqual(value["open"], [
                {"id": "future", "from": "sender", "to": "outside",
                 "where": "inbox", "age_min": -10}])
            self.assertEqual(value["boxes"], {
                "alice": {"inbox": {"REQUEST": 2, "PROGRESS": 1}, "done": 1},
                "bob": {"inbox": {}, "done": 2},
                "empty": {"inbox": {}, "done": 0}})
            self.assertEqual(value["bad"], [
                {"file": "alice/inbox/20261009T1700-no-front.md", "why": "no_frontmatter"},
                {"file": "alice/inbox/20261009T1701-no-field.md", "why": "no_field"},
                {"file": "alice/inbox/20261009T1850-duplicate.md", "why": "dup_id"},
                {"file": "alice/inbox/wrong-name.md", "why": "bad_name"}])

    def test_naive_timezone_empty_reply_and_floor(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            put(root, "a/inbox/20261009T1900-future.md", "future", "REQUEST",
                "2026-10-09T19:00:30", reply="", sender="alpha: beta", to="z")
            put(root, "a/inbox/20261009T1829-recent.md", "recent", "REQUEST",
                "2026-10-09T16:29:59+00:00", to="a")
            result = run(root, "2026-10-09T18:30:00+02:00")
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads(result.stdout)["open"], [
                {"id": "recent", "from": "sender", "to": "a",
                 "where": "inbox", "age_min": 0},
                {"id": "future", "from": "alpha: beta", "to": "z",
                 "where": "inbox", "age_min": -31}])

    def test_invalid_arguments_have_empty_stdout(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            file_path = root / "file"
            file_path.write_text("x", encoding="utf-8")
            cases = [[str(root)], [str(root), "--now", "bad"],
                     [str(root), "--now", "2026-10-09T18:30:00"],
                     [str(file_path), "--now", NOW],
                     [str(root / "missing"), "--now", NOW]]
            for arguments in cases:
                with self.subTest(arguments=arguments):
                    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ENTRY), *arguments],
                                            capture_output=True, text=True)
                    self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2)
                    self.assertEqual(result.stdout, "")

    def test_read_only_directory_preserves_metadata_and_bytes(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            letter = put(root, "a/inbox/20261009T1800-request.md", "q", "REQUEST", NOW)
            inbox = letter.parent
            mailbox = inbox.parent
            paths = (root, mailbox, inbox, letter)
            letter.chmod(0o444)
            inbox.chmod(0o555)
            mailbox.chmod(0o555)
            root.chmod(0o555)

            def snapshot():
                return [(path.stat().st_mode, path.stat().st_size,
                         path.stat().st_mtime_ns,
                         path.read_bytes() if path.is_file() else None) for path in paths]

            try:
                before = snapshot()
                result = run(root)
                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
                self.assertEqual(snapshot(), before)
                self.assertEqual(json.loads(result.stdout)["open"][0]["id"], "q")
            finally:
                root.chmod(0o755)
                mailbox.chmod(0o755)
                inbox.chmod(0o755)
                letter.chmod(0o644)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
